reasons.r.noTaxpayer: Requires applicant not to be an income tax payer.
reasons.r.needBpl: Requires household to hold a BPL or SECC recognized card.
reasons.r.needSenior70: Requires age to be 70 years or above.
reasons.r.needFemale: Scheme is exclusively reserved for women applicants.
reasons.r.needAge18: Applicant must be at least 18 years of age.
reasons.r.age18to40: Applicant age must be between 18 and 40 years.
reasons.r.needBank: Requires an active savings bank account.
reasons.r.needAge60: Applicant must be aged 60 years or above.
reasons.r.needPregnantOrNursing: Requires applicant to be a pregnant woman or nursing mother.
reasons.r.needDaughterUnder10: Requires having a girl child under 10 years of age.
reasons.r.needArtisan: Applicant must be a traditional artisan or craftsperson (18 trades).

reasons.r.incomeMax25: Family annual income must not exceed ₹2.5 Lakh.
reasons.r.needSCorST: Beneficiary must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST).
reasons.r.needFemaleOrSCST: Applicant must be a woman or belong to SC/ST category.

privacy.heading: Privacy & Data Protection Guarantee
privacy.lead: Yojana Setu is built on privacy-by-design under the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) principles.
privacy.rule1Desc: None of your personal answers (age, income, caste, health, family) are ever transmitted to our server or saved in cookies, local storage, or databases.
privacy.rule2Desc: The entire rules engine runs locally inside your browser memory. When you refresh or close this tab, all responses disappear completely.
privacy.rule3Desc: You never need to log in to find schemes or print document checklists. Login exists strictly if you want to save schemes across devices, using only a 6-digit email OTP.
privacy.rule4Desc: You can clear your answers or wipe all saved shortlist data at any time with a single tap.
